text:
leah: quick check-in on the routing editor preview diff UI i put up. main asks: clearer visual diff between current live policy vs the draft, and a faster way to jump from a failing preview event to the inspector for that rule. mock: https://mock.redwood/dev/preview-diff-inspector.png

omar: the side-by-side diff is helpful, but the visual weight is heavy. suggest a compact badge (▲/▼) next to rule titles indicating delta (priority up/down) and a small inline summary: "+2 paths routed". collapsible details on demand.

rachel: +1 for compact badges. also for failures the preview shows a red highlight but no direct action. add a tiny "Inspect" button on the failure marker that focuses the inspector on the rule and opens the validation panel. keyboard users should be able to press Enter when the marker is focused.

ben: implementation thought: when inspector opens from a preview event, we should pass context (simulation id + event index) so the inspector can show the exact input/trace that triggered the failure. maybe a link like `/inspector?sim=123&evt=5`. keep URLs shareable.

kevin: accessibility notes: the diff badges need accessible text (e.g., "Priority increased by 2"). the Inspect button must be reachable via Tab and announce with `aria-label=\"Inspect simulation failure for rule {title}\"`. also ensure `aria-live` updates when the inspector loads the event.

leah: good catches. UX detail: when you click Inspect from the timeline, the canvas should anchor to the rule and highlight the exact condition that fired. visually dim unrelated rules to reduce distraction. we should also provide a lightweight breadcrumb like "Preview > Failure #3 > Rule: BlockIP" so users know where they are.

omar: timeline improvement: add keyboard shortcuts to jump between failures (n/p for next/prev) and show a focusable pill for each failure in the scrubber with accessible labels. jumping should update the canvas and inspector simultaneously.

rachel: copy suggestion: instead of generic "failure" use categories: "Validation error" (config-time), "Simulation mismatch" (runtime difference), "Policy hit" (expected). show a short explanation inline and a link to common fixes. reduces confusion.

ben: for shareability, clicking the inspector "Permalink" should copy a short URL with sim/event context and optionally include a small snapshot of the rule JSON as a query param (or store snapshot server-side for longer retention). include a hover tooltip "Copy link to this simulation event".

kevin: contrast/announce: failure pills in the scrubber currently use red-500; bump to red-700 for text legibility. ensure failure pills have 3:1 contrast against scrubber background for perceivability. also include tests for screen-reader pipeline: scrubber -> event pill -> inspect button.

leah: microcopy: change the preview CTA from "Run preview" to "Run policy preview" and add secondary text under results: "Showing X simulated requests. Use the scrubber or Next/Prev to inspect failures." little clarity goes a long way.

omar: UX flow: if you inspect a failure and then edit the rule, offer a one-click re-run of just that failing request ("Re-run sample") so you can iterate quickly. behind the scenes that can rehydrate the original request context.

rachel: also add a visual indicator in the inspector when the sample is stale vs current draft: "Sample captured at 2025-11-02 14:23 UTC (stale). Re-run to test against current draft." keeps expectations clear.

ben: performance note: when many failures exist, avoid rendering full inspector traces for all. lazy-load traces on demand and show a truncated summary in the scrubber pill. virtualize the scrubber if >200 events.

kevin: keyboard users: ensure focus order is scrubber -> timeline pill -> Inspect -> inspector panel controls. when Inspector gets focus, place focus on the summary header not deep inside the trace. announce: "Inspector loaded for failure #3: {short reason}". include a route for reduced-motion.

leah: next steps: omar will try compact badge designs and keyboard nav; rachel will write the inspector microcopy and failure categories; ben will scope permalink & re-run-sample APIs with backend; kevin will draft the a11y checklist for this flow. i'll update the mock with the Inspect button behavior and post a short vid by EOD.

design-bot: Created task: "POLICY-PREVIEW: inspector-permalinks + scrubber navigation + failure categories" (EPIC-4999).

rachel: one last UX tweak: when a rule has multiple failure events, show a small count on the rule card and expand to list them in the inspector. clicking a specific count item jumps the scrubber to that event.

omar: noted. i'll include clustered counts in the mock and test focus behavior.

kevin: ping me when the vid is up. i'll run axe + manual keyboard checks on the new flows.

leah: thanks team  closing thread until mocks are updated.
